summary: RetryPolicy.from_proto() assigns protobuf RepeatedScalarContainer directly instead of converting to Python list, making activity.info().retry_policy non-picklable and crashing sync activities in ProcessPoolExecutor when retry policy specifies non_retryable_error_types.
userImpact: Sync activities in ProcessPoolExecutor crash with PickleError when workflow specifies non_retryable_error_types in retry policy.
rootCause: RetryPolicy.from_proto() directly assigns proto.non_retryable_error_types (a protobuf RepeatedScalarContainer) instead of converting it to a Python list, which is not picklable.
proposedFix: In RetryPolicy.from_proto(), convert non_retryable_error_types to a list: non_retryable_error_types=list(proto.non_retryable_error_types) or None
workaround: Monkey-patch RetryPolicy.from_proto at import time to convert non_retryable_error_types to a list before returning.
resolutionDetails: Acknowledged by maintainer tconley1428 with commitment to fix in next release.
keyQuote: _pickle.PickleError: can't pickle repeated message fields, convert to list first
